liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Blues For Allah outro (2.42)** (1 review): Reviewer praises Garcia's 70s guitar-hero tone and phrasing on track 31, the Blues for Allah outro [8]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Reviewer finds the instrumental Help on the Way mellow and impressive [4]
- **Franklin's Tower (v)** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Franklin's Tower take primitive yet historically significant [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **x) Crazy Fingers (instr.) (ends with long reverb**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **J. Garcia**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **x) The Music Never Stopped (instr.) (x) (6.08)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **x) Jam (funky stylish?) (fadeout) (6.46)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **Help On The Way (instr., one**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **(x) Slipknot (x) (0.17)**: cut on the recording [9]
- **Spacely Noodling jam (23.01)**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [9]
- **Staccato jam (x) (7.25)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1975-06-07.bluesruffs.sbd.smith.94427.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 67 songs; 252 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [1]

## Around the show

- Guests: J. Garcia soloing over jam [1]
- Stage talk about: drum [1]
- The second half of disc 4 repeats earlier material, and the discs contain many unnecessary track breaks and much repetition [3]
- The Bob Weir studio sessions produced a huge amount of music, much of which was ultimately scrapped [6]
- Faint studio talk is audible in the background, and a Stronger Than Dirt jam features Garcia playing the riff with drummers [1]
- A long compilation mixing March and June 1975 sessions; some material is familiar from other June 1975 sets, plus much freeform jamming [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1975-06-07.bluesruffs.sbd.smith.94427.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Dan Healy; transferred by Matt Smith; source: SBD > Master Reel (Vault Reel) [1]. Also: Four-disc set; the notes list Blues For Allah rehearsals dated March 1975 alongside the June material [1]
